notes: v0.6x // BASALT // GHOSTLIGHT (ALPHA): a usability and feature pass, phone-first. Settings gained a slide-over section drawer and a persistent compact header holding the menu, Back to chat, and Help. A new Skills surface manages per-resident instruction files with fail-closed selection. The Connectors card now configures Nextcloud, Google, Microsoft 365, GitHub, Home Assistant, and OPNsense from Settings with write-only secret fields. Model selection gained saved shortcuts, one-tap chips, and type-to-find across the full provider catalog in every model picker, with search served from a bounded server-side cache instead of shipping whole catalogs to the browser. Four new themes (miku, cyberpunk, dendra, moon) join the roster and the theme setting now accepts a closed set only. The mobile pass fixed narrow attachment bubbles, soft-keyboard chat clipping, wrapping flex rows, themed textareas and file buttons, and a phone-clean shares and setup wizard; keyboard focus is visible on every wizard step. Invites render human-readable meta and clear their code on delete. The response banner no longer discloses stack versions. Exports use private temps, sweep orphans at boot, chunk large queries, stream attachments, and honor an explicit size ceiling. Help and settings copy now match shipped behavior, including honest cookie and transport text. Evidence: 68-check regression bed green on these exact bytes, JS syntax gate 13 blocks, GUI pass at phone and desk widths with zero page errors, manifest round-trip through the shipped validator with teeth-tested negative controls. ALPHA build: automatic update from older builds is not supported. If you run an earlier build, please update manually (download and swap) after taking a backup. Alpha: further hardening is in progress; expect continued fixes before 0.7. Nonce 15.
